Decision: Accept P021 as a new high-value primary experimental MEA paper.
Scientific_Rationale: Peer-reviewed JAC study with exact processing/test conditions, a new alloy family, four RT grain-size conditions and one 77 K condition.
Implementation_Rule: Assign new Paper_ID P021 and five exact experimental conditions.

Decision: Use five independent tensile conditions but only source-supported targets.
Scientific_Rationale: All five are distinct planned tensile conditions; only the 40.9 um RT and 77 K states receive direct mechanism characterization.
Implementation_Rule: Keep 10, 19.5 and 149.6 um RT targets NA rather than extrapolating mechanism labels from Fig.4.

Decision: Assign TRIP=1 at 40.9 um RT and 77 K.
Scientific_Rationale: Both start from single FCC/HCP=0 and show deformation-induced epsilon-HCP after tensile testing; EBSD fractions are 14.9% and 56.2%.
Implementation_Rule: Store direct post-fracture evidence and keep phase fractions as leakage/target evidence.

Decision: Assign RT40 TWIP=1 with reduced evidence strength; keep 77 K TWIP=NA.
Scientific_Rationale: The room-temperature deformed TEM is explicitly described as containing a few mechanical twins. The 77 K condition does not have sufficiently specific condition-wide direct twin evidence.
Implementation_Rule: RT40 Effective_TWIP=1 with medium evidence; 77K Effective_TWIP=NA; never infer TWIP=0 from sparse/ambiguous absence language.

Decision: Initial annealing twins do not generate tensile TWIP.
Scientific_Rationale: All annealed specimens contain abundant annealing twins before loading.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve Twin_Origin=ANNEALING_PRETEST and prevent target leakage.

Decision: Cryogenic pre-generated stacking faults are pre-test microstructure, not post-test leakage.
Scientific_Rationale: The 77 K specimen develops stacking faults during liquid-nitrogen immersion before tensile loading.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve as pre-test condition-specific initial microstructure; do not treat as deformation-TWIP evidence.

Decision: Do not create a numerical direct SFE from the '<23 mJ/m2' statement.
Scientific_Rationale: The source infers an upper bound from mechanism occurrence and literature thresholds; it does not measure or calculate alloy-specific SFE.
Implementation_Rule: Numeric SFE remains NA; preserve raw '<23' as qualitative author-inferred bound.

Decision: Preserve absence of alpha-BCT transformation separately from TRIP/TWIP.
Scientific_Rationale: The paper confirms gamma-FCC->epsilon-HCP but no epsilon-HCP->alpha-BCT transformation.
Implementation_Rule: Store alpha-BCT pathway status separately; do not turn it into a negative TRIP label.

Scientific_Rationale: sigma0 and k are fitted using measured yield stresses from the same tensile dataset.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve as supporting physics/interpretation only; exclude from pre-deformation primary predictors.
